answer: Agents bond stake to a Semaphore membership identity and evaluate its committed epoch polynomial to produce RLN proofs. Each proof binds a message signal to an epoch nullifier and polynomial share; repeating the signal under that nullifier yields distinct shares that can be interpolated to recover the private key. The protocol verifies the exposure and instantly slashes the bond, making Sybil identities costly while keeping an honest voyage anchored to one rate-limited identity.
